Subject: SCCs/UK IDTA/DTIA sampling — procurement intake

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. CardioSuite is preparing procurement docs for our platform procurement team; they raised three items we need your help scoping:

1) SCCs + UK IDTA: confirmation that Redwood will execute the standard SCCs + UK Addendum and whether a separate UK IDTA is required for our UK tenant.
2) DTIA sampling: CardioSuite procurement needs a short sampling plan (what artifacts you’ll provide, typical sampling cadence, and whether you can provide a signed attestation for subprocessors).
3) Subprocessors: we need the current list and whether any third parties have access to raw PII for EU/UK residents.

Attached is our procurement intake questionnaire to capture the minimal artifacts. Can you confirm what you can provide within the next two weeks? We have an internal signing window the week of Nov 30.

Thanks — happy to hop on a brief call if that helps.

Best,
Emma Barnes
Head of Procurement
CardioSuite Inc.
[attachment: CardioSuite_Initial_Questionnaire.pdf]

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the questionnaire.

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 08:14 AM Emma Barnes <emma@cardiosuite.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. CardioSuite is preparing procurement docs...

Quick plan from our side:
- We can commit to the standard SCCs and the UK Addendum. For many customers the UK IDTA can be handled via our UK Addendum + evidence package; we’ll confirm final wording with Legal if procurement requires a separate signed IDTA.
- DTIA sampling: propose a 10-business-day evidence sprint. Deliverables from Redwood would include:
  • subprocessor snapshot and roles
  • sample telemetry and retention screenshots (logs, KV cache retention policies)
  • signed attestation for kms/hsm custody model and access controls
  • completed DTIA sampling template (attached)
- Ask from CardioSuite: the completed questionnaire, a primary procurement contact, and whether you need an accelerated review (we can prioritize).

Attachments I’m sending now: DTIA_sampling_template.xlsx and SCCs_UKAddendum_gaplog.pdf — use the gaplog to mark items CardioSuite expects Redwood to provide as evidence.

Proposed milestone dates:
- Nov 19: kickoff + access checklist
- Nov 24: initial evidence drop (subprocessor snapshot + sampling template)
- Nov 30: final evidence and DocuSign send for DPA redline

If those dates look OK I’ll loop in Marissa (ops) to lock resources. I’ve also CCed Kimberly and Laura for technical/legal clarifications.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: DTIA_sampling_template.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Emma Barnes <emma@cardiosuite.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SCCs/UK IDTA/DTIA sampling — procurement intake

Rachel / Laura / Emma — quick technical notes to help scope the sampling:

- Subprocessors: I attached a short CSV snapshot of current processors (names + roles + regions). Most EU traffic is handled by our EU edge fleet (no raw PII stored outside of encrypted KV cache).
- HSM/KMS: we can provide an attestation of KMS key custody (we use a multi-region KMS with customer-separable keys for Private deployments). If CardioSuite needs an HSM-backed signing attestation, we can coordinate with Infra but that may be on a 5–7 business day cadence.
- Logs and sampling: we can provide redacted log samples and retention settings. For DTIA sampling please confirm whether you need full message-level artifacts or summarized telemetry (we prefer summary / redacted samples for speed).
- Onshore cache fallback: if you require an onshore fallback for UK-resident processing we can propose a configuration path, but note that requires Dedicated or Private deployment SLA commitment.

I’ve attached subprocessor_snapshot_20261115.csv and a short list of the artifacts we can produce in the first drop.

Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: subprocessor_snapshot_20261115.csv]
